card.name: Inside long drug and medical names
card.fires_on: A piece in the middle of a long drug or medical term, just before the rest of the word is completed. Examples are the 'ol' in methylprednisolone, the 'Z' in benzodiazepines and the 'PO' in hematopoietic.

modes.label: Steroid and antibody names
modes.description: Middle pieces of corticosteroid and antibody drug names.

modes.label: Capitalized medical terms
modes.description: Middle pieces of long all-caps terms in warning headings.
